newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cie Bancaire firms on Lehman upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Cie Bancaire firms on Lehman upgrade.

text.p: Shares in French finance and leasing company Compagnie Bancaire firmed on Friday, following an upgrade by Lehman Brothers to outperform from underperform.

The Lehman analyst told Reuters it would take some time for Cie Bancaire to wipe out its property problems but it was on the right track and that from 1998/1999 it should reach a reasonable level of profitability.
The stock was up 1.42 percent at 571 francs in volume of 33,089, while the market was up 0.72 percent at 1535 GMT. mbl/pnt
